Triranga Infra Projects Pvt. Ltd.

RCC Precast Wall
Manufacturers in India

Triranga Infra Projects Pvt. Ltd. Company is a prominent Manufacturers and Suppliers of RCC Precast Wall in India. Our range of RCC Precast Products comprises of RCC Compound Wall, Labour Quarters, Godown/industrial shed, Office Building, Footpath Curbing, Garden Curbing etc. Our RCC Precast are made of premium material and have good ability to resist against chemical attack, weathering action, abrasion, etc. RCC Precast that we provide can easily withstand high pressure conditions. Our Products are manufactured under stringent norms, and the raw materials procured from reputed manufacturers and suppliers are accepted through rigorous quality control norms. All these have enable us to maintain a host of clients.
